Hi Alex — sorry about the hit. Ben and Monica looped in.

Quick troubleshooting I ran:
- Confirmed the invite token issued to greenstone expires in 72h and was created 2 hours ago.
- No global outage in Zip provisioning logs.
- The error string you're seeing maps to a device-binding race we saw in QA with older browser service workers.

Monica — can you check the invite session records for greenstone (company id 987654321) and share the server-side binding logs? If needed we can repro with Alex's account and push a forced reissue.

Alex — can you try the incognito window as a short test? That often bypasses service worker caching causing the token handshake to fail.

Connor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble binding MFA device after Zip invite

On Sep 2, 2026, Connor O'Brien wrote:
> Monica — can you check the invite session records for greenstone (company id 987654321) and share the server-side binding logs?

Checked. Findings:
- Invite token 0x7f4a created 2026-09-02T07:05:22Z, status: active.
- Binding endpoint returned 409 on initial POST: "kv-lock-conflict" then 500 on a retry from the client.
- Client UA shows "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7)" — standard.

Interpretation: There was a transient KV partition lock during the time Alex attempted binding; system retried but client didn't re-fetch updated nonce. Two remediation options:
1) Reissue the invite token (fast, simple) — user will get new link and can bind immediately.
2) Patch client to retry with fresh nonce on 409 (longer).

Recommend reissuing now to unblock. I'll watch logs while Alex retries.

Monica
Platform Reliability (oncall)
Redwood Inference

Alex — we reissued a fresh Zip supplier invite for Greenstone at 2026-09-03T15:05:00-07:00. Monica watched the binding attempt and confirmed success from our side (no 409 observed).

Next steps for your AP team:
- Use the new invite link (should have arrived from "no-reply@redwood.com") — if it doesn't, check spam.
- If you see any client errors, switch to Incognito and retry.

Ben, flag this as unblocked in the CRM and move the onboarding checklist forward. If Greenstone needs a PO routing review once they're in, I'll coordinate with finance.
